Grace / team,

Following up from our demo last week — attaching an initial MAP for the AWS Private Offer and a W9 for your procurement team. The doc outlines three acceptance gates: technical acceptance (perf & stability), security attestation (SOC2 evidence), and billing activation (private-offer acceptance + PO).

High-level suggested timeline:
- Week 0: Sign PO + AWS private-offer handshake (DocuSign)
- Week 1: Technical acceptance sprint (3 tests)
- Week 2: Billing enablement & first invoice run

Can you confirm who owns the PO issuance and whether Axion needs a tax-exempt/VAT form on file? If you prefer, we can swap the MAP to a slightly compressed timeline to meet end-of-month targets.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_Axion_v1.xlsx, W9_karthik_iyer.pdf

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-min call to finalize dates.

— Karthik

Grace — appreciate the quick feedback. I've updated the MAP to include a concise acceptance checklist (attached: Redwood_MAP_Axion_v1.xlsx, highlighted section). Key points:
- Acceptance test checklist (3 items): throughput at target QPS, 99th percentile latency under SLA target, functional regression smoke tests over representative prompt sets. Each item has a "pass/fail" cell and an assignee column.
- Invoice example: we included an illustrative invoice line showing Private Offer ID + Redwood PO reference. Naomi (cc'd) will confirm numbering and invoice cadence.

If PO + DocuSign signature occurs this week we can aim to have the technical acceptance tests scheduled early next week and billing enabled by the following Friday. If that timeline works, I'll put a mutual-action calendar invite.

— Karthik

Hi Grace — quick billing clarifications from Redwood Finance:
- Billing path (AWS Private Offer): AWS executes the payment flow and invoices Axion (AWS invoice) with Redwood on the Private Offer metadata. For Redwood to reconcile, the invoice must include the Private Offer ID and the Redwood vendor reference we will provide after DocuSign.
- Invoice cadence: monthly in arrears by default; we can do NET 30 on the first contracted term.
- Tax: If Axion wants AWS to apply VAT rules, we need your EU VAT number and the appropriate VAT declaration during the offer activation. If you supply a VAT reverse-charge, please attach to the DocuSign envelope or send to procurement@redwood.ai.

I've attached a short PDF with the example invoice line items and required metadata (AWS_Private_Offer_Terms_v2.pdf). Once DocuSign is signed, we will generate the Redwood vendor reference and share with your AP team.

Marissa Cole
VP, Finance Ops | Redwood Inference
